description_expanded: Description Description Prominence on 30A pet-friendly rental, A Pristine Paradise, located in Watersound, Florida by Panhandle Getaways, is a 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhome featuring 2 complimentary golf carts, resort-style community amenities, and convenient access to The Big Chill for dining, shopping, and entertainment. LEARN MORE ABOUT THE PROMINENCE ON 30A NEIGHBORHOOD Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 3 Bedroom Townhome 30A* 2 Golf Carts Included* Pet Friendly* Spacious Deck with Comfortable Outdoor Seating* Large Living Area with Smart TV* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 2 - King Bed, Smart TV* Bathroom 2 - Tub/Shower Combo* Bedroom 3 - Twin Bed, Bunk Bed (Twin/Full), Smart TV* Pack 'n Play Included* Beach Gear, Beach Wagon & Cooler* Board Games* Full Size Washer/Dryer* Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi* Sleeps 8 30A Beach Access Points ABOUT PROMINENCE ON 30A - WATERSOUND, FLORIDAProminence is one of the most popular communities on 30A and features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Prominence is perfectly located to new and long time 30A haunts as well as the beautiful white beaches of Scenic 30A. Guests will enjoy a beautiful town center and 2 resort style pools. Located at the town center, the Big Chill is a hot-spot for entertainment and features an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen for sporting events and movie nights on the green. Concerts, family activities, restaurants, and boutique shops are just some of the things to do within a less than 5 minute walk. Prominence is centrally located on 30A between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys and Rosemary Beach to the east. COMMUNITY and THE BIG CHILL AMENITIESWalking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops & Nightly EntertainmentCigar and Gastro Pub - Luke Bryan's Place & Popular HangoutOnsite Ice MachineKids Movie Nights and Sports Viewings at the Hub2 Large Community Pool(s) with Zero Entry (no steps) – perfect for the elderly and toddlersBarbecue AreasProximity to the amenities at Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seaside5 miles to nearest Grocery Store BONUS***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) Please note: Pool heated seasonally is subject to change at any time by the HOA for the community. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any change in seasonal heating of the one pool in Prominence. No refunds for any change to pool heated seasonally. Beach Accesses for ALL Prominence homes are via South Walton public beach access points. Most Prominence guests utilize Deer Lake State Park beach access or other nearby public beach accesses. Prominence homes do not have direct beach access via Watersound Club nor do they have access to Watersound private club facilities. NOTE: Beach gear, Pack 'n Play, and board games are provided as a courtesy. Availability cannot be guaranteed, and no refunds will be issued if any of these items are unavailable during your stay. PET FRIENDLYAn additional non-refundable pet fee is collected after booking. Any damage caused by pets will incur a minimum fee of $350. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach.
